name: edge-cms
description: Build, set up, launch and update Edge CMS sites in a Hub: the edge-block-package, edge-design-to-site, edge-figma-design, vue-to-block-migrator, edge-site-setup, edge-site-launch and edge-skill-impact skills, the Hub's remote CMS tools (draft-only), and Chrome DevTools for launch checks.

interface.shortDescription: Build and edit Edge CMS sites as drafts in a Hub
interface.longDescription: The Edge CMS skills (block packages, design to site, Figma design, Vue/HTML to block migration, site setup, site launch, skill impact), the Hub's remote CMS tools and Chrome DevTools for launch checks. Everything the CMS tools change is a draft: people publish pages and release blocks in the Hub. Sign in with your Hub account the first time the tools are used.
